army-ritual-hot-stone.title: Speak the analogy of the hot stone
army-ritual-hot-stone.description: As a hot stone falls silent in water, so may the addressee's battle grow cold.
army-ritual-hot-stone.matchRule: Spoken analogy by which a hot stone cooling in water quells hostility.

army-ritual-winter-torpor.title: Bind the rivals by the torpor of winter
army-ritual-winter-torpor.description: As winter's torpor seizes, so may the spells likewise seize the speaker's rivals.
army-ritual-winter-torpor.matchRule: Spoken binding of enemies by a seasonal analogy.

army-ritual-mighty-troops.title: Pray that the troops be mighty
army-ritual-mighty-troops.description: The speaker asks that his troops be mighty.
army-ritual-mighty-troops.matchRule: Petition for the strength of one's own army.

army-ritual-father-gods-protect.title: Ask the father-gods to protect the son
army-ritual-father-gods-protect.description: The speaker asks the father-gods to protect the son, young and grown, and rejoice in his life.
army-ritual-father-gods-protect.matchRule: Petition to ancestral gods for protection of a named person.

army-ritual-gods-on-our-side.title: Declare the gods are on our side
army-ritual-gods-on-our-side.description: The speaker declares that the gods have stepped to their side and the kings have spoken for them.
army-ritual-gods-on-our-side.matchRule: Declaration of divine alignment with one's party.

army-ritual-hasten-troops.title: Ask that the troops be hastened
army-ritual-hasten-troops.description: Great and small together are asked to hasten the troops along.
army-ritual-hasten-troops.matchRule: Petition that one's troops move swiftly.
